import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static int n, k, mod;
    static long[] fac;
    static long[] inv;
    static long[][] dp;
    
    static int lowbit(int x) {
        return x & (-x);
    }
    
    static long fpow(long x, int y) {
        long res = 1;
        while (y > 0) {
            if ((y & 1) == 1) {
                res = (res * x) % mod;
            }
            x = (x * x) % mod;
            y >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }
    
    static void init() {
        fac = new long[n + 1];
        inv = new long[n + 1];
        fac[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            fac[i] = (fac[i - 1] * i) % mod;
        }
        inv[n] = fpow(fac[n], mod - 2);
        for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            inv[i] = (inv[i + 1] * (i + 1)) % mod;
        }
    }
    
    static long dfs(int x, int s) {
        if (dp[x][s] != -1) {
            return dp[x][s];
        }
        if (s == 0) {
            return dp[x][s] = (fac[n] * fac[k] % mod) * inv[k - x] % mod;
        }
        int now = s - lowbit(s);
        long res = 0;
        for (int t = now; t != 0; t = (t - 1) & now) {
            res = (res + dfs(x + 1, t) * inv[s - t]) % mod;
        }
        res = (res + dfs(x + 1, 0) * inv[s]) % mod;
        return dp[x][s] = res;
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        mod = sc.nextInt();
        init();
        long ans = fpow(k, n);
        if (n % 2 == 0) {
            dp = new long[27][1 << n]; // maximum size based on problem constraints
            for (int i = 0; i < 27; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < (1 << n); j++) {
                    dp[i][j] = -1;
                }
            }
            ans = (ans - dfs(0, n) + mod) % mod;
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
